_readme: The simplified VOIDtv show list: TV from 1990 to now. Home page rows are the TYPES; the network is a label on the card. scripts/show-probe.js checks each name against the Internet Archive. Add or remove entries freely. "tags" are cross-row collections (e.g. Black Programming): filterable, each gets a shelf.
